payload.posture: Read Deuteronomy 34:7–11 as evidence about the Spirit, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states deuteronomy 34:7–11 uses spirit language for an inward condition or decision that is locally described; the local wording centers on “Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
